column4: Wide panoramic sky backdrop painting for a stylised 3D game skybox, seen from sea level. The horizon line is perfectly straight and horizontal, located at the bottom quarter of the image; above it, a huge dramatic stylised cloudscape fills the top three quarters; below the horizon only a thin band of soft distant sea haze. Absolutely NO boats, NO ships, NO land, NO islands, NO rocks, NO birds, NO people, no text, no letters, no logos. Saturated stylised colours, soft painterly-3D toy-world clouds with bold readable shapes, evenly spread across the whole width so the left and right edges look similar. Golden afternoon: warm gold sunlight glow low in the centre-left sky behind clouds (sun disc hidden behind cloud), cream and peach cumulus, a darker bruised violet squall line of storm clouds advancing across the upper sky, clear turquoise-blue gaps, gold rim light on cloud edges.

Illustrated key art for a video game title screen, stylised AAA 3D render, cinematic 16:9, NO text, NO letters, NO logo, no UI, no names or lettering painted on the hulls (plain glossy hulls). Chunky toy-like nautical world in glossy painted enamel and varnished timber, bold silhouettes, saturated signal colours. Two glossy toy yachts, one signal red and one sunflower yellow, charge at each other head-on on a huge curling emerald-teal storm wave, their chunky toy captains with big hats (red oilskin and yellow sou'wester vs a navy tailcoat and tricorn) lunging with striped jousting lances that meet in the centre in a burst of cream spray and splinters. A giant bright cyan lightning bolt strikes down behind them from bruised violet storm clouds, a low gold sun breaking under the clouds, cream foam and spray everywhere, heroic dynamic composition centred, empty calmer sky in the top quarter for a logo.
